Bug_Details:
This code creates a database connect using a hardcoded, constant password. Anyone with access to either the source code or the compiled code can
    easily learn the password.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by hardcoding the database password directly in the connection URL within the showBug method.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method of the DatabaseConnector class, which contains a hardcoded database password in the connection URL. This triggers the bug related to the hardcoded constant database password.
